project.name: A-DMFE (Adaptive Dynamic Multi-Service Feasibility Engine)
project.description: Admin dashboard + backend engine simulating and dispatching ride/food/parcel requests via 5-factor compatibility scoring, adaptive batching, OR-Tools route optimization, and an explainable-AI (XAI) decision layer, paired with an IEEE-paper-track reviewer-evidence evaluation harness.

architecture.pipeline: Request -> Compatibility scoring -> Batching (static or adaptive) -> Decision engine -> OR-Tools route optimization -> Driver/vehicle selection -> Trip -> Analytics -> XAI explanation -> Live map highlight
trigger_paths: manual: dmfe_v2.py /analyze (used by frontend 'Run Analysis' button)
manual: dmfe_engine.py per-stage endpoints (implemented, tested, NOT called by frontend)
automatic: services/simulation_service.py background SimulationEngine tick (the actual production dispatch trigger)

frontend.app_build_blocker: App.jsx imports frontend/src/components/ui/AnimatedBackground, which does not exist anywhere in the repository

algorithms.compatibility_scoring: 5-factor model (pickup proximity, route/destination similarity, time-window compatibility, vehicle capacity fit, priority) in backend/app/dmfe/compatibility.py
algorithms.batching: greedy disjoint pairing (static mode) or context/learning-adjusted thresholds (adaptive mode) in backend/app/dmfe/batch_generator.py
algorithms.route_optimization: OR-Tools Pickup-and-Delivery-Problem solver in backend/app/dmfe/optimizer.py, single-request fast path bypasses solver
algorithms.adaptive_layer: backend/app/dmfe/adaptive/* - context awareness, persisted learning state, adaptive weight generation, adaptive thresholds
